PROJECT.PROJECT_TITLE: Climate Change and Starch Yield in Maize
PROJECT.PROJECT_SUMMARY: Comparison of unaltered inbred maize endosperm metabolite pools with corresponding tissues from the same time in development but from plants lacking both PDK1 and PDK2
PROJECT.ADDRESS: 2154 Mol. Biol. Blg, ISU, Ames, IA

STUDY.STUDY_TITLE: PPDK RNAi effects in endosperm metabolite pools
STUDY.STUDY_SUMMARY: Maize plants were transformed with endosperm-specific PPDK RNAi knockout constructs to alter starch/protein ratios. Metabolite pool comparisons will be examined from sibling kernels harvested from segregating ears.

COLLECTION.STORAGE_CONDITIONS: ear frozen in liquid N2, kernels removed while frozen, and maintained at -80C

TREATMENT.PLANT_GROWTH_LOCATION: Woodruff Farm, Story Co., Ames, IA
TREATMENT.PLANT_PLOT_DESIGN: 10 plants/row; random row placement over 0.5 acres
TREATMENT.PLANT_LIGHT_PERIOD: natural sunlight and day length, summer 2014
TREATMENT.PLANT_HARVEST_DATE: Each ear is segregating both mutant and wild type kernels, thus the harvest and freezing for the controls is the exact same as the mutant sibling kernels from the same ear.
TREATMENT.PLANT_METAB_QUENCH_METHOD: flash frozen in liquid N2, maintained at -80C

MS.INSTRUMENT_NAME: Thermo Q Exactive Orbitrap Thermo Scientific- Q Exactive
